fusions.name: Branching Gore
fusions.desc: Gores an enemy for 14 piercing damage, makes it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on it branch out to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Staghorn Shards
fusions.desc: Snaps off 3 antler tines and looses them in a spread, each dealing 3 piercing damage with a 25% chance to leave the target [Bleeding] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Velvet Regrowth
fusions.desc: You regain 3 health a second for 8 seconds. You resist water damage by 10%.

fusions.name: Crown of Reef
fusions.desc: Conjures armour of coral: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 8%, your maximum health by 10, and 10% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
